scientific_integrity: A direct incidence proof and explicit constructions are supplied; bounded tests reproduce the displayed signatures and counts. Historical priority is subject to other unindexed work.
scientific_limitations: The uniform blocklength condition is sufficient; it is not asserted to be minimal for each list size.
Only three-symbol unordered sources and exactly two unordered survivors are covered.
The even-list equality restrictions are necessary but do not classify all maximizers.
Finite computational checks support but do not establish the symbolic infinite theorem.
Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
title: High-list saturation for ternary two-symbol multiset deletion codes
